title: Broken water meter
description: The protective cover of the shared water meter is broken and its mechanism is exposed. Please inspect the meter and arrange a replacement before the next reading.

attachments.alt: Damaged water meter with its cover open and mechanism exposed

title: Lift stops between floors
description: The lift stopped briefly between the second and third floors this morning. Nobody is trapped. It is currently out of use; please arrange a technician inspection before returning it to service.

title: Leaking pipe in the basement
description: Water is dripping from the joint on the cold-water pipe near the basement entrance. A bucket has been placed underneath. The plumber has been contacted and access to the basement is available.

title: Light out on the third floor
description: The light above the third-floor landing no longer turns on. The other lights are working. Please replace the bulb and check the motion sensor.

title: Entrance door does not close
description: The main entrance door was not closing fully. The door closer has now been adjusted and the latch checked. The entrance closes securely again.
